Description: Uncovered a JSON Web Token, which may lead to unauthorized access to web applications and sensitive user data.
Author: Brad Wilcox
Message:
feat: add Supabase magic-link edge gate (founder-only) (#9)

This internal dashboard was publicly accessible. Add the run-rate edge-gating
pattern: middleware validates a Supabase session + ALLOWED_EMAILS allowlist
before serving public/index.html. Auth backend is the shared aaa-internal-auth
project (magic-link). login + callback added under public/.
